queries.sql:
SELECT 'version' AS dim_type, version_id::VARCHAR AS code, version_name AS label, version_type AS meta
      FROM SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.FACT_PLAN_VERSION WHERE is_locked = FALSE
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'version', version_id::VARCHAR, version_name, version_type
      FROM SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.FACT_PLAN_VERSION WHERE is_locked = TRUE
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'dim_primary', member_name, member_name, level_number::VARCHAR
      FROM SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.DIM_DIMENSION_MEMBER WHERE dimension_name='dim_primary' AND is_active=TRUE
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'dim_secondary', member_name, member_name, level_number::VARCHAR
      FROM SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.DIM_DIMENSION_MEMBER WHERE dimension_name='dim_secondary' AND is_active=TRUE
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'dim_tertiary', member_name, member_name, level_number::VARCHAR
      FROM SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.DIM_DIMENSION_MEMBER WHERE dimension_name='dim_tertiary' AND is_active=TRUE
        AND member_name IN (SELECT DISTINCT dim_tertiary FROM SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.FACT_PLAN_ENTRY WHERE dim_tertiary != 'ALL')
      UNION ALL
      SELECT 'dim_quaternary', member_name, member_name, level_number::VARCHAR
      FROM SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.DIM_DIMENSION_MEMBER WHERE dimension_name='dim_quaternary' AND is_active=TRUE
        AND member_name IN (SELECT DISTINCT dim_quaternary FROM SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.FACT_PLAN_ENTRY WHERE dim_quaternary != 'ALL')
      UNION ALL
      SELECT DISTINCT 'period', period,
        CASE
          WHEN LENGTH(period) = 7 THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(period || '-01','YYYY-MM-DD'),'Mon YYYY')
          WHEN LENGTH(period) = 6 THEN TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(period || '01','YYYYMMDD'),'Mon YYYY')
          ELSE period
        END,
        NULL
      FROM SNOWCONSO_RVG_DE.PUBLIC.DIM_TIME
      ORDER BY 1, 3
